verdict.rationale: Bevy itself functions as the official SDK: it's described as 'just a normal Rust dependency' with ECS components/systems as plain Rust code, backed by reference docs, quick-start guides, and browsable examples (bevy-docs-21, 14, 42, 43, 22, 27, 34). However, there is no AI-native tooling layer — probes show no llms.txt, no markdown-doc endpoints, and no OpenAPI spec (bevy-probe-1, bevy-probe-2, bevy-probe-3), and community feedback notes docs are thin beyond examples (bevy-comm-14, bevy-comm-17). Missing for 10: AI-oriented SDK affordances (llms.txt, machine-readable docs/spec), and confirmation that AI agents can reliably code-generate against the API beyond human-oriented tutorials.
